newsitem.title: USA: ARCO sees L.A. hydrocracker off line May 2.
newsitem.headline: ARCO sees L.A. hydrocracker off line May 2.

text.p: Atlantic Richfield Co will begin two weeks of planned maintenance this weekend on a 40,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) gasoline and diesel-making unit at its Los Angeles refinery, the company said Tuesday.
The unit, a hydrocracker, will be down for two to three weeks starting May 2.
"It's just a routine maintenance turnaround," said Walter Neil, ARCO refinery spokesman.
Neil said he did not know the amount of unleaded gasoline and diesel the unit produced.
Wholesale CARB diesel fuel eased two cents Tuesday to 65/66 cents, traders said.
